symptom: javac: package org.junit.jupiter.api does not exist
cause: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 kept the /c/Users/... form of $HOME, which javac on Windows cannot open

symptom: generated parser held literal newlines inside "\n" string escapes
cause: the spec-format patch was applied through a shell heredoc, which turned the escapes into line breaks
correction: escapes restored; generator edits go through the Write/Edit tools, never a heredoc

cause: the hidden-class seed was a nested class; Class.isMemberClass on the hidden copy checks its InnerClasses attribute against the outer class
correction: seed is a generated minimal top-level class file (no InnerClasses attribute)

symptom: bash: unexpected EOF while looking for matching quote
cause: spec text over the Bash tool command-length limit
correction: spec files are written with the Write tool

symptom: WrongMethodTypeException: handle's method type (..)void but found (..)Object
cause: a void invokeExact call used as an expression-lambda body is typed Object (not an expression statement)
correction: void invokeExact calls inside lambdas are written as block lambdas { atom.invokeExact(..); }

symptom: missing argument 'setup' for a SCENARIO row without setup
javac: method retained() is already defined
cause: a spec helper shared its name with a generated atom method
correction: generator refuses a helper declaration named like a generated atom method; helpers renamed (retainedBoundary, boundaryOf, findMode)
evidence: clash detected for M3Boundary.of and M3TokenEngine.find

symptom: next(Transition,int) returned -1 for a present label
cause: the test positioned the cursor with initTransition, which stores an absolute lane offset; next() expects a fresh cursor (transitionUpto -1), as Lucene's MinimizationOperations uses it
correction: cursor created fresh with source set; initTransition is only for getNextTransition

cause: the generator's assertion gate does not see assertions inside an ordinary helper
correction: language helper renamed assertLanguage (assertion-named helpers only)

cause: java.util.regex reads {2,3} after a?-quantifier as literal braces

symptom: concatenate() expected to accept the empty string
cause: the zero-operand concatenation keeps Lucene 9.10 Operations behaviour (one non-accepting state)
correction: expectation pinned to Lucene parity and reported as a contract observation

symptom: capture mismatch for a priority-safe pattern
cause: real defect: M3TokenEngine.alternative evaluated the second branch from the shared scratch registers rewritten by the first branch
correction: M3TokenEngine.alternative evaluates the second branch from a copy of the incoming registers; regression assertion in M3TokenEngine.alternative
